u:
PPTP Client is a Linux, FreeBSD, NetBSD and OpenBSD client for the proprietary Microsoft Point-to-Point Tunneling Protocol, PPTP.

This script configures PPTP Client on Linux.

<dl><dt data-o="">--create TUNNEL</dt><dd>create a tunnel named TUNNEL</dd><dt data-o="">--delete TUNNEL</dt><dd>delete the file /etc/ppp/peers/TUNNEL and any lines from /etc/ppp/chap-secrets that contains "TUNNEL" as a single word</dd><dt data-o="">--server SERVER</dt><dd>the IP address or host name of the server</dd><dt data-o="">--domain DOMAIN</dt><dd>the authentication domain name (optional)</dd><dt data-o="">--username USERNAME</dt><dd>the username you are to use</dd><dt data-o="">--password PASSWORD</dt><dd>the password you are to use. If you don't specify a password, pptpsetup will ask for one.</dd><dt data-o="">--encrypt</dt><dd>whether encryption is required</dd><dt data-o="">--start</dt><dd>whether the connection should be started after configuration.</dd></dl>
Nelson Ferraz <nferraz at gmail.com>, based on James Cameron's PPTP Client Debian HOWTO.
